p: third month: Which was in the beginning of the month of Sivan, containing part of May and part of June.
day came they into the wilderness: That they departed from Rephidim.
Jacob: God called Jacob, Israel: therefore the house of Jacob and the people of Israel signify God's people.
eagles' wings: For the eagle by flying high, is out of danger, and by carrying her birds on her wings rather than in her talons declares her love.
sanctify them to day and to: Teach them to be pure in heart, as they show themselves outwardly clean by washing.
wives: But give yourselves to prayer and abstinence, that you may at this time attend only upon the Lord, 1Co 7:5.
quaked greatly: God used these fearful signs, that his law would be held in greater reverence, and his majesty even more feared.
voice: He gave authority to Moses by plain words, that the people might understand him.
priests and the people break through: Neither dignity nor multitude have authority to pass the bounds that God's word prescribes.
